data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: gh run list --workflow=reconcile-bridge.yml --limit 1 executes without authentication error (may be empty on fresh repo)
- Closure Check: Verification command output logged as story comment

## Given / When / Then
**Given**: tests from b456-9a60-ce0c-4b8c exist and are RED
**When**: verify-gha-runner.sh is implemented
**Then**: all tests pass

## Acceptance Criteria
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/verify-gha-runner.sh exists and is executable
- Runs `gh auth status` first; exits 1 immediately if auth fails (no further commands run)
- Runs `gh run list --workflow=reconcile-bridge.yml --limit 1`; captures stdout+stderr
- On success: logs output as story comment via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 7705-41e8-9f01-4ebb`
- On gh run list non-zero exit: exits 1 (does not log partial output as success)
- Script reads STORY_ID from env (default: 7705-41e8-9f01-4ebb) to allow re-use for other workflows
- Script reads WORKFLOW_NAME from env (default: reconcile-bridge.yml)

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/verify-gha-runner.sh (CREATE)

## Dependencies
- b456-9a60-ce0c-4b8c (RED tests must exist first)
data.title: GREEN: Implement verify-gha-runner.sh
